intended_use: Non-commercial research. Published artefacts contain derived statistics only (errors, ranges, scores), never raw third-party data. The registry records what is confirmed and what remains an assumption; it does not download anything and does not make network calls.

statuses.CATALOGUED: Source is catalogued (URL, publisher, licence, coverage and fields checked on the web page or documentation); no data has been retrieved into the project yet.
statuses.NOT_DOWNLOADED: Source is identified and needed, but access is paid/licensed or manual and no data has been retrieved; nothing may be cited as observed from it.
statuses.ACCESS_VERIFIED: The public page and its terms/licence page were checked on a dated verification run (HTTP status, page/terms SHA-256, licence/coverage/field markers) and recorded in protocols/source_verification_log.jsonl. No data was retrieved into the project: retrieved_at must stay null. ACCESS_VERIFIED is access evidence, NOT observed data and NOT VERIFIED; it must never be cited as observations.
statuses.VERIFIED: The source was actually retrieved into the project and its identity was checked against the dataset/manifest used (retrieved_at is set and the note points to the evidence). Only VERIFIED may be cited as observed data.
